message.content:
This document is the README and technical documentation for **Project Maya**, a system for running large open-weight language models locally on consumer and prosumer hardware. Here are its key technical points:

## Models and Quantization
- Supports **GLM-5.3-Flash**, **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**, and **MiniMax-M3.1-Flash**, each offered in multiple Maya quant sizes (XS, S, M, L) plus third-party quants (unsloth GGUF, EXL3, abliterated variants).
